name: Somchai Chancharoen
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While working at a local fabrication shop in Bangkok, a chance encounter with a visiting race team sparked an interest in precision engineering. He quickly immersed himself in the world of machining, mastering techniques like CNC milling and lathe operation. His dedication and natural aptitude led him to roles with increasingly prominent racing teams, culminating in his current position at Allied Racing.

Somchai's approach is characterized by meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to pushing the boundaries of performance. He's known for his ability to diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues, often devising innovative solutions that others overlook. His talent lies in understanding the interconnectedness of every component, ensuring that each part contributes to the overall efficiency and reliability of the race car. He is a strong believer in preventative maintenance, aiming to identify and address potential problems before they arise on the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a wiry build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and ideas.
Has a habit of humming softly while working on intricate parts.
Insists on cleaning his tools with a specific type of oil, believing it improves their lifespan.
